newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB quiet on report of St George buys.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB quiet on report of St George buys.

text.p: The National Australia Bank Ltd declined to comment on Friday on media reports it had increased its stake in St George Bank Ltd, which is pursuing a friendly A$2.65 billion takeover of Advance Bank Australia Ltd.
"We are not making any comment about it," a NAB spokesman told Reuters.
Newspaper reports on Friday said a broker used by NAB bought over one million shares or about 0.5 percent of St George's issued capital in the market on Thursday.
NAB had a 6.8 percent stake in St George at the time the Sydney-based regional bank announced the merger with its regional rival, Advance, this month.
St George on Friday could not explain the sharp rise in the bank's share price on Thursday, when it closed at itS high for the day of A$9.05.
"We don't know," a St George spokesman said.
St George shares were trading nine cents below Thursday's close at A$8.96 at 12.25 p.m. (0125 GMT) on friday.
